reason: #2632 (automations) adds five requires_component_surface tests in tests/src/e2e/workflows/automation/test_native_contract.py: the reference validator's area-target warning, which needs the component's registry ids; the automation_config bridge's validate answer; the references Core reports for a loaded automation; the not-loaded warning for a registry-disabled one; and Core's none/all match sentinels, which reach the validator only through the component. All skip at collection on the two no-tools lanes without an active server entry (plain container, HAOS inaddon) and run everywhere else.
